camera.z_display: fixed initial pooled quantiles; original MPa labels

semantics.reference: stored noisy synthetic observations; display only, not physical truth
semantics.height: fixed nonlinear display mapping; read raw MPa from each point
semantics.surface: positive Gaussian visual smoothing of all 6000 raw tuned predictions
semantics.color: prediction display-surface MPa minus same-XY synthetic reference-surface MPa
semantics.optimum: maximum raw prediction among unlabelled development candidates; all ties retained
semantics.animation: decorative breathing must preserve raw predictions and point anchors

website_metadata.simulation_labels: Stored original_dataset_noisy_simulation outcomes; no physical measurements
